Gift watches under $6,000: Grand Seiko SBGW279, Cartier Tank Must WSTA0108, WSTA0106, WSTA0141 and Breitling Superocean Automatic 42 (A17366D81C1A1).

Listed prices: USD 4,100 to USD 5,700. The Cartier and Breitling prices are from their US sites (20–21 Nov 2026). Grand Seiko and WSTA0141 are from Watches of Switzerland.

Prices change and do not include tax. Check the retailer before you buy.
